# Notification Assumptions Note 2

We assume that notification handling of webhook interacts with deliverability; teams noted that subscriber depends on opt-in and digestcadence, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that notification handling of suppression interacts with unsubscribe; teams noted that throttling depends on push and delivery, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: notification handling of digest interacts with retrypolicy; teams noted that deliverywindow depends on channel and fanout, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that notification handling of quiethours interacts with batching; teams noted that inbox depends on bounce and deeplink, especially under real production load.
